SLOOP for the M-Vave SMK-37

The SLOOP groovebox firmware on the SMK-37, in two builds. Install and edit from this page: Chrome or Edge, over USB.

Back up first. Before the first install, make a full 1 MiB flash backup of your keyboard: its calibration, Bluetooth pairing and key_mac are its own and no package contains them. How to back up. Back up your projects with the editor too. Unofficial firmware, not affiliated with or endorsed by M-Vave. No warranty.

Audio stems

SLOOP 2.8.1 with USB audio stems for a DAW, punch-ins on every stem, the stem punch-in page, sequencer effects and DAW mode. Every engine and the built-in samples.

Mewcoder

SLOOP 2.8.4 with your voice in over USB audio on track 3, dry or through a 20-channel vocoder modelled on the Sennheiser VSM201, played from the keys and the sequencer. A lean build: some engines and the built-in samples make room for it.

Install

SMK-37 Elitethe vocoder build (Elite only)

Open the editoreverything, and the Vocoder tab

Read

  • Mewcoder's page: what it adds, what it leaves out, the manuals
  • The vocoder manual
  • The release: the package and its SHA-256
In development: the harmoniser. Your voice pitch-shifted into up to three harmony voices, modelled on the Eventide H949: its delay memory, feedback, REVERSE and REPEAT, and its big ratio readout. It will come to Mewcoder when it is ready.

Each installer checks that the package matches your keyboard before it writes anything, and never erases your projects, presets, samples or settings. Use the editor that goes with the build you installed. To go back to the stock firmware, use M-Vave's own updater (M-UPGRADE).
